mechanism.claim: Bitcoin's first UTC half-hour return carries information into the final UTC half-hour. On days beginning after an already high-variation 24-hour state, follow the completed first-half-hour direction only during 23:30-24:00 UTC.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed 00:00-00:30 UTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVHOW learns four six-hour weekly slots from labels. Intraday path candidates enter immediately after their feature blocks. HVTOCM freezes a published first-to-last half-hour timing relation, waits 23 hours without consuming intervening data, and trades only the final 30 minutes; no prior event set or control is reused.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one high-variation 23:30 UTC entry with a 30-minute hold is absent from Gross9

literature_context.supported_direction: the first half-hour positively predicts the last half-hour return, with greatest predictability when the opening session has high volume or volatility

features.variation_window: exact 289 BTCUSDT 5m closes from D-24h-5m through D-5m, producing 288 completed close-to-close returns before D
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 prior valid UTC days, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.opening_half_hour: exact six completed contiguous BTCUSDT 5m bars [D,D+30m)
features.information_embargo: no bar, price, volume, funding, OI, premium, or outcome between D+30m and the 23:30 entry is a signal input
features.validity: exact unique grid, finite positive coherent OHLC, no imputation

clock.decision: D+00:30 UTC after opening half-hour completes
clock.scheduled_entry: D+23:30 UTC open; signal is held unchanged without observing an eligibility input during the wait
clock.reservation: global half-open; one position per UTC day
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only during economics

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

definitions.no_variation_gate: opening-half-hour momentum every valid UTC day
definitions.opening_half_hour_fade: negative opening-return sign on the primary clock
definitions.second_half_hour_momentum: strict sign of [00:30,01:00) return on the same scheduled 23:30 clock and variation law
definitions.one_day_stale_opening_return: previous valid UTC day's opening-return sign on the primary eligibility clock

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published fixed first-to-last half-hour timing effect plus user-requested high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no UTC day, variation, opening window, embargo, entry, side, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
